items.title: US will not resume strikes on Iran before midterms — Trump
items.description: President Donald Trump said the US will not resume strikes on Iran before the midterm elections on November 3. High gas and grocery prices are top concerns for voters.

items.description: The developing El Niño may impact the UK's weather prospects this autumn and winter but cold conditions are far from guaranteed.

sections.title: Beyond Climate — Other Major EU News

items.title: EU envoy in Beijing for talks to calm trade tensions
items.description: The EU trade envoy said he hoped to make progress in tackling the bloc's "unsustainable" trade imbalance with China. Beijing called for trade disputes to be resolved through equal dialogue.

items.title: Security in the Black Sea region: is Bulgaria the weak link in Europe's defense against threats from Russia?
items.description: Two ships have sunk off the coast of Bulgaria and Romania after drone attacks in recent days. Bulgaria has held back on pointing the finger at Russia. What does that mean for security in the Black Sea and the region?

items.title: Middle Corridor: Can Bulgaria be a safe gateway for Asian imports to the EU?
items.description: The EU wants more trade via the Middle Corridor, which could bring big benefits for Bulgaria. But Tuesday's drone attacks on commercial ships off the Bulgarian coast are a stark reminder of the security risks involved.

items.title: EU pulls sponsorship from Disinfo2026 event in Lithuania
